title: Grateful Dead Live at Community War Memorial Auditorium on 1982-04-09

ai_review.summary: Great audience recording of a high‑energy early‑80s show highlighted by a sparkling Bird Song, though a few note the mix sounds slightly hollow.
ai_review.review: The tape captures an enthusiastic performance with loose, dancing vibes on the first set and memorable moments like Jerry’s soaring Bird Song and a solid rendition of Satisfaction as the closer. The audience recording is praised for its clarity and positioning, despite occasional comments about a thin or “hollow” sound. Overall the show is viewed as a strong representation of the band’s late‑golden‑age era.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate the show 3–5 stars and highlight strong musical moments; recording quality is generally praised as clean, with only minor complaints about hollowness, leading to a combined rating just above 4.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Several reviewers describe the audio as very clean, clear and well‑positioned; a few note a slightly hollow or thin mix but no major dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is jam‑filled and loose with dancing crowd energy; second set continues the high vibe and ends with a strong performance of Satisfaction.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers praise Jerry’s playing, calling it a “great Jerry period” and noting his soaring Bird Song that hooked many listeners.
